body: Meet the Olympus Sprinter 170 AWD, a bespoke camper van crafted for seamless remote work and endless adventure. This unique build showcases a bright, open interior highlighted by a striking tiled backsplash and a custom fold-down butcher block desk.

Tailored specifically to its owner's needs, this van is equipped with a robust solar system and substantial battery capacity to meet all electrical demands. It features a comprehensive plumbing setup, including indoor and outdoor showers, and a convenient dry flush toilet.

Experience year-round comfort with premium insulation, a roof-mounted A/C unit, and a diesel-powered heater. The kitchen boasts a practical yet elegant acacia butcher block countertop, a portable induction cooktop, and a stainless steel sink.

Designed for both functionality and aesthetic appeal, the van incorporates painted shiplap siding, a wood-stained ceiling, and durable vinyl wood-style flooring. Generous storage solutions, such as overhead cabinets and a floor-to-ceiling closet, ensure ample space for all essentials.

Additional highlights include a full-size bed area, swivel seats for versatile living spaces, and carefully placed windows for natural light and scenic views. Finished in Papago White with stainless steel fixtures, the Olympus Sprinter 170 AWD exemplifies personalized craftsmanship tailored to enhance every journey.
